name: codex
title_zh: 把 Codex CLI 变成你手下的自动改码工
tagline_zh: 说一句“跑 codex”，它就知道该 exec 还是 resume。不用记参数、不用翻文档，改完代码还能接着上次的。
tagline_en: Say "run codex" and it knows exec from resume. No flags to memorize, no docs to dig — pick up where you left off.
desc_en: Use when the user asks to run Codex CLI (codex exec, codex resume) or references OpenAI Codex for code analysis, refactoring, or automated editing
why_zh: 它把 Codex 的两种入口封装成意图判断：分析/重构走 exec，续聊走 resume。
why_en: It wraps Codex's two entry points into intent detection: exec for analysis/refactor, resume for follow-ups. Fewer keystrokes.
limit_zh: 只认本机已装好的 Codex CLI，且只处理 exec/resume 两种调用。不负责装环境、不解析输出。
limit_en: Requires Codex CLI pre-installed; only handles exec/resume. No env setup, no output parsing, no complex multi-turn branching — else it hands back to.
